subject: math
description: Set up and solve proportions from similar triangles, with careful attention to corresponding side labels.
learningObjectives: Identify corresponding sides in correctly ordered similar triangles
Write proportional side ratios from a similarity statement
Use cross-products to solve for a missing side length
Apply proportions in embedded and nested triangle diagrams
Use a parallel side splitter to form similar triangles and solve missing measures
Detect and correct wrong side correspondences before solving
prerequisites: Recognize similar triangles from matching angle markings
Solve one-step and two-step linear equations
Read side labels and vertex order carefully in geometry diagrams
